feedback: You have written a thoughtful and balanced response regarding cellphone use in schools. Your focus on equity—ensuring that students without devices are not disadvantaged—is a particularly strong point that adds depth to your argument. To improve, try to strengthen your introduction by clearly stating your position in a single, compelling thesis statement. Additionally, you could enhance your writing by using more varied sentence structures and more precise vocabulary to elevate the tone. Your logical progression of ideas is effective, and you have successfully addressed the concerns of both teachers and learners. Well done on maintaining a professional and persuasive tone throughout your piece.
